ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast; approximately 96% low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels vs 4% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized at distal tips and surface scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity dark gray mass across the entire visible ventral surface. High-contrast white/yellowish pixel clusters localized at the left and right distal tips. Sparse, isolated high-intensity focal points scattered across the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated vertex angle of approximately 92 degrees with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke center mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; approximately 14-18 distinct peaks of varying pixel-amplitude (3-12 pixels) along the continuous boundary of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in an upward-pointing terminal orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters on the lower-left and mid-right lobe surfaces, consistent with individual barnacle attachment scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned high-intensity linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, appearing as singular diagonal scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-frequency textured pixel clusters (likely barnacle colonization) causing geometric irregularity at the absolute distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Proninent vertical furrows or ridges of medium-intensity pixels radiating from the peduncle insertion point toward the trailing edge across the central fluke region.
